consequence.label: first aid or minor property damage

dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy

facts.title: unplanned release of thermal energy at PSV-8201

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 1 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control PRESSURE_RELIEF_DEVICE_INTEGRITY: the setting, testing and sealing of pressure relief devices was in place but did not perform, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an individual or team action.
Control STORED_ENERGY_DISSIPATION: the dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy was not in place, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy on PSV-8201 and record the critical control verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in verifying pressure relief and protection, specifically setting, testing and sealing pressure relief devices. PSV-8201 (steam relief devices) is in service for boiler and deaerator overpressure protection. The task proceeded during commissioning of replacement equipment while the setting, testing and sealing of pressure relief devices was in place but did not perform. The thermal energy involved is held as hot surface, and the recorded presentation was burn, ignition, scald.
response.summary: On 7 February 2019 a potential incident was recorded on PSV-8201 at Tolgarra Processing and Power Station during commissioning of replacement equipment; thermal energy held as hot surface was not released.
